evidence_spans: The MO-PhC slab features a periodicity of a = 850 nm, a thickness of t = 200 nm, and a square-hole side length of L = 460 nm, with cladding and substrate indices n1 and n2, as shown in Fig. 2A.
The MO-PhC slab features a periodicity of a = 850 nm
All numerical simulations were performed using COMSOL Multiphysics.
CLM-PHOT-0026.statement: In the MO-PhC slab simulation, the periodicity is 850 nm.

extra_quotes: All numerical simulations were performed using COMSOL Multiphysics. A single unit cell of the magneto-optical photonic crystal slab was modeled with Bloch periodic boundary conditions along the x and y directions and perfectly matched layers along the z direction.
Material absorption was neglected throughout the simulations.
